root_cause: The live provider returned syntactically valid JSON, but section claims cited evidence IDs outside their section-scoped citation allowlists. The second full retry reduced but did not eliminate the allowlist violation.
ui_contract_issue: The API returned HTTP 200 for a terminal failed task and wrote a zero-byte Markdown report. The UI treated response.ok plus an empty report as an ambiguous completed-without-report state instead of displaying FAILED_PROVIDER_SCHEMA.
fix_summary: API response now exposes succeeded, terminal, error_code, and report_available.
Failed tasks no longer write blank Markdown report files.
Research UI treats status, succeeded, and report_available as the completion contract.
Provider retry path now supports component-level section repair for invalid sections only.
